notes: MANUALLY CREATED RECORD. Ellen M Larkin's mother — maiden name McALONE from both children's GRO birth registrations (owner's lookups); FORENAME ELLEN and survival to at least Apr 1911 from the owner's 1911 census pull (wife, 46, of household head William Larkin at 8 Peters Court, Whitehaven). Daughter Ellen was evidently named for her.

HUSBAND CORRECTED: the census head — and thus the children's father — is WILLIAM Larkin (M0003, b. ~1857), not the export's 'Thomas'. The 'Mary Ellen Larkin d. Mar Q 1906 aged 42' is therefore some other Whitehaven Larkin's wife — this Ellen was alive in 1911.

At ~46 in 1911 with a 4-year-old and five+ children spanning ~1894-1906, she was ~41 at Ellen's birth — unremarkable, and the audit's original 'age 52 mother' anomaly (built on the Blackmore chimera) is fully dissolved.

OPEN: her birthplace (census image column); marriage to William (not registered in Cumberland 1880-1911 — Ireland likely, given the community); her death (after Apr 1911; Ellen emigrated alone in 1921 — did her mother die 1911-1921, or stay behind with the older children?). Samuel's or Ellen's birth certificate (~£12.50) would confirm her forename independently.
